newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds Chem figures expected Jan 7 or 8.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds Chem figures expected Jan 7 or 8.

text.p: Britain's Lloyds Chemists Plc said on Monday it expected to report second-half sales figures on Tuesday or Wednesday, within its normal timeframe of the first 10 days of the year.
"It's our intention to announce our second-half sales figures either tomorrow or the day after," a spokesman for the pharmacy chain operator and wholesaler said.
Britain's Unichem Plc and Germany's Gehe AG are locked in a long-running battle to take over Lloyds, which has advised investors to wait and see whether the firms raise their bids.
The spokesman said Lloyds was not expecting to make any further statements on the bid situation ahead of January 17, the deadline for the rival bidders to increase their offers.
At the end of last week, Unichem's stock and cash offer valued Lloyds at about 486p per share, while Gehe's all-cash bid stood at 500p per share, the Lloyds spokesman said.
The value of Unichem's offer has fallen with the company's share price in recent weeks.
However, the spokesman said Lloyds' board had yet to take action in favour of either suitor.
On Monday, Unichem said it held 10.1 percent of Lloyds, including acceptances representing about 0.4 percent of the target's ordinary shares, barely changed from the level it reported a month ago.
Gehe said on December 23 that it had received valid acceptances of its offer representing about 0.16 percent of Lloyds' ordinary shares.
Lloyds' shares rose 4.5p to 514.5 by 1109 GMT, while Unichem gained 0.5p to 246.5p. In Frankfurt, Gehe's shares rose 30 pfennigs to 97.90 marks.
